These asymmetric six-color 60×40 PNG/JPEG/TIFF fixtures were encoded with Pillow,
with EXIF/TIFF orientation values 1 through 8. The corresponding reference PNGs
come from Pillow's ImageOps.exif_transpose (TIFF's loader applies orientation).
JPEG uses quality 100 and no chroma subsampling. PDF comparisons allow a small
JPEG decoder rounding difference; PNG and TIFF comparisons are exact.
